title: DailySign
description: Simple signing datapack. / 简单的签到数据包
body:
# DailySign

### Sign-in plugin, but minecraft datapack 签到插件，但是数据包

Using namespace `dlsign`, scoreboard objective prefix `dlsign.`, simulate-player name `#dlsign`

## Features 功能特点

- Datapack format so it runs on almost all server 原生运行
- Configurable sign reward/miss-sign punishment 可配置的签到奖励/补签惩罚
- Completed missing sign and patching sign 完备的断签修补机制

## Usage 食用方法

1. Download and install as a normal datapack 像往常一样下载安装
2. Config functions available at `data/dlsign/function/config` 配置函数在 `data/dlsign/function/config`
3. Daily init function runs through `/schedule function dlsign:day_after_day\new_day 72d`, so just run `dlsign:day_after_day\new_day` on 24:00 realtime to calibrate the datapack. 每日重置使用72个游戏日作为周期（ `/schedule function dlsign:day_after_day\new_day 72d`），在现实时间24:00运行 `dlsign:day_after_day\new_day`以校准数据包
4. Enjoy your sign journey!
